newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Metal Manufactures in tax dispute.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Metal Manufactures in tax dispute.

text.p: Cable and building products group Metal Manufactures Ltd (MML) said on Friday it remained in dispute with the Australian Tax Office (ATO) over potential liabilities of A$31.6 million.
MML said the ATO had just completed a routine tax audit and on Thursday issued amended tax assessments for the calendar years 1989 to 1994 which claimed a total of A$25.8 million.
These claims related to a sale and leaseback transaction in which the company said it had legal and taxation advice that still strongly supported its position.

"Accordingly MML does not consider that it has a case to answer and vigorously refutes the ATO challenge in the strongest possible terms. MML confirms that in accordance with its previously adopted position it will not be making a provision against profits in relation to this matter," it said.
MML said these claims were in addition to a A$5.8 million amended assessment issued by the ATO for the 1988 calendar year.
The company, which is 62 percent-owned by BICC Plc, achieved a net profit of A$46.85 million in calendar 1995 and paid tax of A$13.16 million.
